crossRefs.note: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me. My spirit drinks up their poison. The terrors of God set themselves in…
If I have sinned, what do I do to you, you watcher of men? Why have you set me as a mark for you, so that I am a burden…
I was at ease, and he broke me apart. Yes, he has taken me by the neck, and dashed me to pieces. He has also set me up…
His archers surround me. He splits my kidneys apart, and does not spare. He pours out my bile on the ground.
If a man doesn’t repent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.
He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.
For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.

translations.web: He has bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
translations.bsb: He bent His bow and set me as the target for His arrow.
translations.kjv: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
translations.asv: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
